paragraphs: Seneca Polytechnic (formerly Seneca College) is one of Canada's largest public polytechnic institutions, located in the Greater Toronto Area. Founded in 1967, Seneca serves over 32,000 full-time students including a substantial international community from over 130 countries, across campuses in Toronto (North York), King City, and Markham.

Seneca offers more than 250 programs spanning business, technology, aviation, healthcare, media, arts, and design. The institution is particularly well regarded for its aviation flight operations, cybersecurity, data analytics, broadcasting, and business programs. Seneca has strong industry partnerships with Toronto's leading technology, finance, and media companies.

International students at Seneca benefit from Seneca International's dedicated support services, English for Academic Purposes preparation, and access to the Greater Toronto Area's vast employment and networking ecosystem. Seneca's programs include extensive co-op and work-integrated learning opportunities.

Toronto is Canada's economic capital — home to Canada's largest concentration of financial services, technology companies, and media organisations. International graduates of Seneca's programs qualify for the Post-Graduation Work Permit, providing access to Toronto's unmatched job market and pathways to Canadian permanent residency.
paragraphsRu: Seneca Polytechnic (ранее Seneca College) — один из крупнейших государственных политехнических институтов Канады в Большом Торонто. Основан в 1967 году, ежегодно обслуживает более 32 000 студентов из 130+ стран.
Seneca предлагает более 250 программ: бизнес, технологии, авиация, здравоохранение, медиа, искусство и дизайн.
Иностранные студенты Seneca получают специализированные услуги, EAP-программы и доступ к огромной бизнес-экосистеме Большого Торонто.
Торонто — экономическая столица Канады. Иностранные выпускники Seneca имеют право на Post-Graduation Work Permit.
